scenicChapters.title: Bregenz → Schreckensee
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 61 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 9 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

city-bregenz-dayout.story: From Bregenz it runs 251 km to Bregenz; allow about 4 h 20 of riding. On the way it passes Schreckensee, Konstanz-Hinterhausen, Unteruhldingen-Stollenwiesen and Litzelstetten-Krähenhorn 32. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It crosses from Austria into Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.

scenicChapters.title: Kalkalpen - Urlach → Kalkalpen - Hintergebirg
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-kalkalpen-urlach-ybbs-kleinkastel.story: From Micheldorf in Oberösterreich it runs 289 km to Micheldorf in Oberösterreich; allow about 4 h 59 of riding. On the way it passes Kalkalpen - Hintergebirg, Dürrenstein-Lassingtal, Ybbs - Kleinkastell and back through Dürrenstein-Lassingtal. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
